## How it was verified

<!-- Delete what doesn't apply. -->

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Tested against a live Odoo instance — version: <!-- e.g. 17.0 / 15.0 -->
- [ ] Docs / `skills/` guidance updated to match

## Checklist

- [ ] **No changes to `dist/`** — build artifacts are regenerated by a maintainer
      at release time (`git checkout origin/main -- dist/` if a local build dirtied it)
- [ ] **All commits are signed off** (`git commit -s`, or `git rebase --signoff origin/main`)
- [ ] No credentials, live URLs, database names, or real customer data anywhere in
      the diff or the description
- [ ] If a tool's parameters changed: **both** the static JSON schema in
      `src/tools/schemas.ts` **and** the co-located Zod schema were updated
- [ ] If a mutating tool was added or changed: it still requires an explicit
      `justification` and writes to the audit trail
- [ ] Tests added or updated to cover the change
